text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! 
1st place slipped away...!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!! That was so close!!
You'll win next time!!
Keep fighting!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!!
I'll definitely cheer for you in your next race, tooo!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone...!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Oguri-senpai...!
Look at you, totally composed already...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, I've still got a long way to go...!
I have to get stronger, much stronger...!!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your running was truly incredible.
It felt so hot I thought I'd get burned...
It fired me up too. That was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Let's run again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Without fail, next time...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whyâ

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Why were you able to fearlessly challenge Oguri-san today
and stay true to your own running,
even while staring right into her terrifying stride...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When faced with that same immense and unfathomable power,
back then I was made painfully aware... of the difference in our strength... of my own powerlessness... And yet—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Because it's so massive and extraordinary,
isn't that what makes it the best?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful that Oguri-senpai is running
ahead of me as such an insanely strong Umamusume, 'ssu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Because the stronger Oguri-senpai is, the closer I get, and the more I win—the hotter and more incredible the challenge and showdown will be!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why Oguri-senpai isn't someone who devours dreams.
If anything—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"She makes my challenges, my 'dreams'!
She makes me shine even brighter!
She's the strongest, most awesome Umamusume out there!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So that is where the difference between you and me lay...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere along the way, I might have forgotten.
The mindset one must hold when challenging the "strong"—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Bamboo-san.
Do you think I can do it too?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To challenge the 'strong'
head-on—just like you."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course I can do it!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Because challenging the 'strong' to elevate
yourself... That's what you taught me,
Yaeno!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wish to reclaim my original resolve, challenge the "strong" once more,
and forge ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Toward my... "dream"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san,
your expression looks much brighter now!
I'm so glad...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed Bamboo-san's splendid run,
she must have felt the same way we did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...A power that strives toward a "dream"
more straightforwardly than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san is really the kind of Umamusume
who gives courage to other people's "dreams"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I truly think so, too—

And when we returned to the academy.
Bamboo Memory, who had been quieter than usual
on the way back, suddenly stopped in her tracks.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your running was truly incredible.
It felt so hot I thought I'd get burned...
It fired me up too. That was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Let's run again.
(Tear drops)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, wait, what?!
W-W-W-What in the world is thisss?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second!
I'm okay, really... I'm totally fine...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, seriously...!! It's just,

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm just, ah…… I'm just so happy……!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To finally, truly compete against her...
against Senior Oguri with everything I had in a GⅠ race—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm just so haaaappy...!
Suddenly, large tears began spilling one after another from Bamboo Memory's eyes.
It was the quietest, yet fiercest passion she had ever shown—a burst of pure fury.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely her.
From the very beginning until now, she's been my destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The greatest rival, and the greatest showdown."
At the center of my dream, after all,
is Oguri-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, that's why I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to become
the best rival for "Oguri Cap."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To Oguri-senpai! And to everyone!
That 'Bamboo Memory is Oguri Cap's greatest rival'!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna become the kind of me!!
That can make everyone feel that way...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
For our next race, please let it be
the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I'm definitely gonna become the strongest sprinter ever!
An even, even more awesome version of me, worthy of being Oguri-senpai's rival...!!
Bamboo Memory's passionate feelings, strong enough to bring tears to my own eyes, were received loud and clear.

Then—now it's my turn as her Trainer to deliver!
To turn her from here on out into "Oguri Cap's ultimate rival"...!
choice_data_list: Before that, let's enter the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Medium distance...!?
choice_data_list: I think it's going to be a tough battle. But—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But...?
choice_data_list: Yaeno and Chiyono O appear in that one.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

It won't just be Yaeno Muteki and her rivals.
Other powerhouses of the generation will show up too.
That is the Grand Prix race known as the Takarazuka Kinen.

Bamboo Memory has spent time with peers like
Yaeno Muteki, fueling the fire of her "dream."

"In that case, fighting with everything we have here,
in a race where the 'dreams' of our generation gather—"
choice_data_list: It's definitely going to make you stronger!
It's definitely going to make you stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!!
My next race has gotta be the Takarazuka Kinen! Please let me run it!!
